observation.visible_scene: A surfer in a dark-red wetsuit crouches on a board inside the hollow barrel of a large, slow-breaking green ocean wave under a pale overcast sky; choppy grey water fills the foreground. From roughly the middle of the clip a second person (head and shoulders in a dark wetsuit, one hand raised near the head) appears at the bottom-right edge, watching. The wave's curling lip and a white foam curtain on the right dominate the scene and evolve throughout.
visible_changes: The surfer keeps a low, braced stance on the board and drifts leftward and slightly downward in the frame, becoming progressively more hidden by the wave's closing curtain.

The curling lip and the breaking whitewater on the right grow and advance leftward, narrowing the open barrel and increasingly occluding the surfer (by the last frames only a small portion of the rider is still visible).
A foreground spectator's head and shoulder enter the bottom-right corner around t≈1.2–1.3 s and remain for the rest of the excerpt.
The pale sky and horizon stay essentially fixed, so the main visible motion is the wave's break and the rider's travel within it rather than a large camera sweep.
outside_clip_unknowns: What preceded the excerpt (the surfer's drop-in and entry into the tube).
Whether the rider escapes the closing barrel or is engulfed after the segment ends.
The spectator's exact activity (e.g. holding a camera vs. shielding the eyes).
uncertain_details: Whether any camera pan/zoom accompanies the action (background evidence is limited).
Whether the surfer's leftward shift is his own line through the tube or the wave closing around him.
The precise meaning of the spectator's raised hand.
